extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders and researchers searching Federal Register regulatory documents (agency staff, regulated parties, public commenters)
extracted.subtask_description: Search-results listing of Federal Register documents matching the term 'APA', aggregating excerpts from Notices, Proposed Rules, and Rules across multiple agencies; useful for finding regulatory standards, procedural statements, and application requirements referencing 'APA' (Administrative Procedure Act) or organizational acronyms named APA.

rubrics_metrics.name: FCA manufacturer's application completeness requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The manufacturer's application must be complete and include: (i) detailed diagram of the device; (ii) complete list of the chemical compositions, formulations and quantities used in the device; (iii) results of the thermal stability test; and (iv) signed certification declaring that the device for which certification is requested conforms to the APA 87-1A, APA 87-1B, or APA 87-1C, as appropriate. The device must comply with the appropriate APA standard and be assigned an FC number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: PHMSA proposes expanding FCA authority to approve fireworks constructed to APA 87-1B and 87-1C and revising procedural regulations to facilitate new FCA authorizations. The excerpt emphasizes completeness (diagram, chemistry, test results, signed certification) and conformity to the applicable APA standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: FMCSA HOS exemption safety equivalence and carrier eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Exemptions will be granted only where FMCSA determines the exemptions 'will likely achieve a level of safety that is equivalent to or greater than the level that would be achieved in the absence of the exemptions.' FMCSA ensures each motor carrier possesses an active USDOT registration, minimum required levels of insurance, and is not subject to any 'imminent hazard' or other disqualifying condition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: FMCSA evaluated APA's application and member companies' safety records before granting exemptions. The agency analyzed applications and public comments and set terms and conditions for exemptions. Eligibility checks include registration, insurance, and absence of imminent hazards.

rubrics_metrics.name: HOS exemption scope and operational conditions (APA fireworks exemptions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requested exemption would allow drivers to exclude off-duty and sleeper berth time of any length from the calculation of the 14-hour limit and to use paper records of duty status (RODS) in lieu of an electronic logging device (ELD) during a designated Independence Day period (e.g., June 28 through July 8), with requests covering specified multi-year periods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: APA justified need due to increased demand for fireworks; members agreed to provide additional driver training on proper rest periods; FMCSA solicited public comment and previously granted similar temporary exemptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Criteria for adding member companies to existing APA HOS exemptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests to include additional member companies must demonstrate those carriers meet the same conditions required for exemptions (e.g., safety records, USDOT registration, insurance) and will operate under the same terms (excluding off-duty/sleeper berth time and using paper RODS during the specified period).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: FMCSA announced receipt of an application to extend exemptions to 12 additional member companies and referenced prior exemptions granted for other companies; the agency reviews company-specific eligibility and continuing need.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification requirements under the National Cooperative Research and Production Act
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards-development organizations must file written notifications with the Attorney General and the Federal Trade Commission disclosing (1) the name and principal place of business of the standards development organization and (2) the nature and scope of its standards development activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: The notice for APA—The Engineered Wood Association states notifications were filed pursuant to section 6(a) of the Act, disclosing organizational identity and standards-development scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative Procedure Act 'good cause' exception for notice-and-comment
rubrics_metrics.description: Under the APA, when an agency for 'good cause' finds that notice and public comment are 'impracticable, unnecessary, or contrary to the public interest,' it need not follow notice-and-comment procedures before modifying or repealing rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: Multiple agency documents (e.g., FCC suspension/debarment adoption, FMCSA technical corrections, Commission rule adoptions) invoke this exception, noting prior notice and comment may be 'unnecessary' for routine or insignificant administrative changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: APA exception for rules of agency organization, procedure, or practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Agency actions that are rules of organization, procedure, or practice fall within an exception to the APA's notice-and-comment requirements and therefore can be issued without prior public comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: FMCSA and other agencies cite this exception when amending parts that only alter agency procedures, practice, or internal organization and do not impose new material requirements on the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory override of APA notice requirements (e.g., Inflation Adjustment Act)
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain statutes can require agency action 'notwithstanding' APA section 553; e.g., the Inflation Adjustment Act directs agencies to adjust civil monetary penalties without regard to section 553 of the APA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: The Department of Labor's annual inflation adjustments cite the statute's direction and explain that APA notice-and-comment and related Regulatory Flexibility Act requirements do not apply when statute so directs.

rubrics_metrics.name: APA requirement that agencies conclude matters within a reasonable time; mandamus relief
rubrics_metrics.description: The APA requires that a Federal agency 'conclude a matter presented to it . . . within a reasonable time,' and courts have authority to 'compel agency action unlawfully withheld or unreasonably delayed' (e.g., mandamus petitions seeking deadlines for rulemaking).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: EPA's notice of a proposed settlement agreement references a mandamus petition alleging EPA's delay violated this APA requirement; the settlement would set deadlines for final action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limits on delegation to District Managers under MSHA and APA/Appointments Clause concerns
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions that allow District Managers to require additions or changes to plans (e.g., roof control, ventilation, training) may raise statutory and constitutional concerns (Appointments Clause) and may violate the APA if they effectively promulgate new substantive rules without notice-and-comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: MSHA proposes revising regulations to eliminate the District Manager's authority to require additional measures because that authority may exceed statutory delegation, implicate the Appointments Clause, and skip APA notice-and-comment procedures; MSHA seeks comments on these issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information-collection requirement for Request for Special Priorities Assistance (APAS)
rubrics_metrics.description: The information collection established by the APAS regulation is necessary for an applicant to request prioritization of a contract above all other contracts; the purpose is to obtain items in support of national defense programs that are not obtainable through normal market channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: The Farm Production and Conservation Business Center requested comments under the Paperwork Reduction Act on an extension of the information collection supporting APAS Priority Rating requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Airspace modification criteria to support IFR/VFR operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Airspace modifications (e.g., expansion of Class D radius, revocation of Class E extensions) are made to better contain instrument departures until reaching specified altitudes (e.g., 700 feet), to account for rising terrain, to resolve overlaps with nearby airspace (e.g., Buckley Space Force Base), and to support instrument flight rules (IFR) and visual flight rules (VFR) operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: The Centennial Airport actions describe changes in radii and bearings, separation distances in nautical miles, and operational rationales (rising terrain, overlap of circling maneuver radii) as the basis for proposed or final airspace amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHMSA proposal to expand FCA approval authority and streamline procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: PHMSA proposes to expand Fireworks Certification Agency authority to approve fireworks constructed to additional APA standards (87-1B and 87-1C) and to revise procedural regulations to facilitate new FCA authorizations, intending to streamline the approval process and provide regulatory flexibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: The NPRM lists elements of compliance and documentation required for approvals and proposes procedural changes to authorize FCAs to handle devices meeting additional APA standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of 'good cause' and organization/procedure exceptions when changes do not create new compliance burdens
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies may rely on 'good cause' or the 'organization/procedure' APA exceptions to issue final rules without prior notice if the change corrects technical errors, removes obsolete references, or does not impose new material requirements or increase compliance obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surrounding guidance: FMCSA's technical corrections to the FMCSRs and other agencies' direct final rules use this rationale to avoid notice-and-comment when revisions are non-substantive and administrative.
